operations.description:
Initiates discovery of Azure resources within the specified scope. Always asynchronous: the
service returns 202 Accepted with polling headers, and the polling endpoint returns 204
No Content when the operation completes successfully. Track progress and the resulting
findings via the corresponding `DiscoveryRun` child resource.
operations.name: Microsoft.ResourceMover/moveProjects/discover/action

operations.description:
Exports move applications and all of their members to a CSV file. The optional OData filter
uses the same allow-list as `MoveApplications.listByParent`: `applicationType`,
`discoveryRunId`, and `status`. Unsupported expressions are rejected with 400 InvalidFilter.
Requests above the limit of 10 live staged export files are rejected with 429
TooManyStagedFiles until an existing file expires.
operations.name: Microsoft.ResourceMover/moveProjects/exportApplicationsCsv/action

operations.description:
Creates a fresh, short-lived, read-only URI for an exported applications CSV file. Invalid or
cross-project file names are rejected with 400 InvalidFileName. Missing or expired files are
rejected with 404 DownloadNotFound. The download URI expires after 60 minutes.
operations.name: Microsoft.ResourceMover/moveProjects/getCsvDownloadUri/action

operations.description:
Creates a short-lived, create-only URI for staging an applications CSV file. The project may
have at most 10 live staged import files. Requests above that limit are rejected with 429
TooManyStagedFiles until an existing file expires. The upload URI expires after 15 minutes.
operations.name: Microsoft.ResourceMover/moveProjects/getCsvUploadUri/action

operations.description:
Imports move applications from a staged CSV file. The service validates the project-bound file
name and uploaded content before accepting the operation. Preflight rejects a missing upload
with 404 UploadNotFound, a file over 25 MB with 413 CsvTooLarge, and unsupported content
encoding with 400 InvalidContentEncoding. A concurrent live import is rejected with 409
ImportAlreadyInProgress. Terminal ValidationFailed errors apply no changes and include up to
1000 details; terminal ApplyFailed errors may leave previously committed changes in place.
operations.name: Microsoft.ResourceMover/moveProjects/importApplicationsCsv/action

operations.description:
Exports move applications and all of their members to an XLSX workbook in Blob Storage.
The optional JSON body contains an OData filter. Admission returns an empty 202 with polling
headers; fileName, rowCount, exceedsImportLimit, and expiresOn are available only in the
terminal operation output. Exchange the completed fileName using the shared getDownloadUri
action to download workbook bytes from Blob Storage. The optional OData filter
uses the same allow-list as `MoveApplications.listByParent`: `applicationType`,
`discoveryRunId`, and `status`. Unsupported expressions are rejected with 400 InvalidFilter.
Requests above the limit of 10 live staged export files are rejected with 429
TooManyStagedFiles until an existing file expires. Errors use the standard ARM ErrorResponse;
throttled responses include Retry-After.
operations.name: Microsoft.ResourceMover/moveProjects/exportApplicationsWorkbook/action

operations.description:
Creates a fresh, short-lived, read-only URI for an exported applications discovery workbook or a
move-plan XLSX workbook in Blob Storage. This JSON action returns a SAS URI, not workbook
bytes; download the file directly from Blob Storage. Invalid or cross-project file names are rejected with 400
InvalidFileName. Missing or expired files are rejected with 404 DownloadNotFound. The download
URI expires after 60 minutes. Failures use the standard ARM ErrorResponse.
operations.name: Microsoft.ResourceMover/moveProjects/getDownloadUri/action

operations.description:
Creates a short-lived, create-only SAS URI for staging an applications XLSX workbook in Blob Storage.
Upload workbook bytes directly to that URI using the service-issued .xlsx file name before invoking
`importApplicationsWorkbook`; this JSON action does not receive workbook bytes. The project may
have at most 10 live staged import files. Requests above that limit are rejected with 429
TooManyStagedFiles until an existing file expires. The upload URI expires after 15 minutes.
Failures use the standard ARM ErrorResponse; retry throttled requests after the Retry-After delay.
operations.name: Microsoft.ResourceMover/moveProjects/getWorkbookUploadUri/action

operations.description:
Imports move applications from an XLSX workbook already uploaded to Blob Storage using
`getWorkbookUploadUri`. Supply only the service-issued fileName in JSON, not multipart content
or workbook bytes. Admission returns an empty 202 with polling headers; successful completion
returns 204 with no content. Invalid workbooks are rejected with 400, unauthorized access
with 403, missing uploads with 404, concurrent
imports with 409, oversized workbooks with 413, throttling with 429, and temporary service
unavailability with 503. Retry-After indicates the delay for retryable responses.
operations.name: Microsoft.ResourceMover/moveProjects/importApplicationsWorkbook/action

operations.description:
Imports move applications from an XLSX workbook already uploaded to Blob Storage using
`getWorkbookUploadUri`. Supply only the service-issued fileName in JSON, not multipart content
or workbook bytes. Admission returns an empty 202 with polling headers; successful completion
returns 204 with no content. Invalid workbooks are rejected with 400, unauthorized access
with 403, missing uploads with 404, concurrent
imports with 409, oversized workbooks with 413, throttling with 429, and temporary service
unavailability with 503. Retry-After indicates the delay for retryable responses. Asynchronous
validation can fail with `ValidationFailed` and `DependencyCycleDetected` details, including
for draft applications. Dependencies outside an application are nonblocking warnings.
operations.name: Microsoft.ResourceMover/moveProjects/importApplicationsWorkbook/action

polling headers, and the polling endpoint returns 204 No Content when the operation completes
successfully.

operations.description:

completes successfully.

operations.description:
Finalizes the batch move, committing the changes. Always asynchronous: the service returns 202

operation completes successfully.

operations.description:
Prepares the batch for the move. Always asynchronous: the service returns 202 Accepted with

operations.description:
Exports the batch's move plan as a human-readable, multi-section CSV report. Always
asynchronous: the service returns 202 Accepted with polling headers, and the terminal
operation status carries `output.{ fileName, rowCount, exceedsImportLimit, expiresOn }`.
Rejected with 409 when no plan exists yet for the batch.
operations.name: Microsoft.ResourceMover/moveProjects/moveBatches/exportMovePlanCsv/action

operations.description:
Finalizes the move batch after a successful move. Always asynchronous: the service returns
202 Accepted with polling headers, and the polling endpoint returns 204 No Content when the
operation completes successfully.
operations.name: Microsoft.ResourceMover/moveProjects/moveBatches/finalize/action

operations.description:
Prepares the move batch for the move. Always asynchronous: the service returns 202 Accepted
with polling headers, and the polling endpoint returns 204 No Content when the operation
completes successfully.
operations.name: Microsoft.ResourceMover/moveProjects/moveBatches/prepare/action

operations.description:
Exports the batch's move plan as a four-sheet XLSX workbook (Summary, Validations, Resources,
Appendix). Always asynchronous: the service returns 202 Accepted with polling headers and an
empty body; the terminal operation status carries `output.{ fileName, expiresOn }` (modeled as
the final 200 response). The workbook is downloaded by exchanging `fileName` via
`getCsvDownloadUri`. Rejected with 409 when no plan exists yet for the batch, and with 413 when
the plan exceeds the maximum exportable size.
operations.name: Microsoft.ResourceMover/moveProjects/moveBatches/exportMovePlan/action

operations.description:

the final 200 response). The workbook is downloaded by exchanging `fileName` via
`getDownloadUri`. Rejected with 409 when no plan exists yet for the batch, and with 413 when
the plan exceeds the maximum exportable size.
